task.title: Implement gateway failure routing metadata
task.summary: Add failure_class, recommended_next_loop, and stop/wait routing metadata so gateway fail/block outcomes retry locally or escalate to the smallest safe upstream loop.

goal.outcome: Gateway fail/block reports and graph reconciliation carry explicit routing metadata so failures can retry locally, escalate to planning/decision, collect proof, or wait on runtime coordination without defaulting to broad decision-loop reroutes.
acceptance: Validation tool input, domain types, and Pi schema accept documented routing metadata such as failure_class, recommended_next_loop, and stop_reason without breaking existing callers.

Validation reports persist the routing metadata for explicit inputs and derive safe defaults for known policy/preflight gaps, including decision_propagation -> planning, risk_approval -> decision, content_proof/immutable proof gaps -> validation or publication proof, commit_readiness/compiler output gaps -> implementation, and audit/evidence gaps -> validation retry/preflight.
Graph reconciliation reads validation routing metadata for fail/block reports and uses it to choose next_loop and reason before falling back to existing default routing.
At least one smoke or feature test proves validation report persistence and graph next-loop selection for a planning_gap or risk_approval_missing route.
Skills or system docs that instruct validators mention the new metadata and preserve pass/fail/block as the verdict contract.
non_goals: Do not implement transition probability metrics, Markov dashboards, or agency optimization in this task.
Do not add a canonical raw transition event log.
Do not replace graph state-machine behavior with a Markov chain.
Do not redesign validation policy or risk tiers beyond adding routing metadata.
verification: Targeted smoke test covering validation routing metadata and graph reconciliation
implementation validation with fresh context and checked content proof

delta.desired: Fail/block validation reports carry route metadata and graph reconciliation uses it for selective back-propagation.
delta.current: Gateway fail/block verdicts name criteria and graph routing often falls back to broad decision-loop reconciliation.
